description: Workflow for writing tests against requirements — verifying that a feature, endpoint, or function behaves correctly according to its specification, not according to its current implementation. Reads the spec/requirement and the surface being tested (signatures, contracts, observable behavior); deliberately avoids mirroring implementation logic into the tests. Suitable for adding coverage after the fact in a codebase without strong test culture. Does not modify production code (use /ship) and does not review existing tests as part of a code review (use /review-code).
